task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data from 2 patients. You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patient, two measurements was taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). Load the data, perform preprocessing and quality control. Keep only cells with single BCR chain pair. Keep only cells for which both BCR and RNA-seq data exist. Annotate cell types using cell_type.py script. Across all pre-vaccination samples, which cell type expresses IGKV4-1 the most (not counting for Naive B cells)? Will this hold if splitting pre-vaccination data per-patient? Output patient id in which it doesn't hold or '-' if it holds. What's mean heavy chain junction sequence length for plasmablasts? In what cell type (across all samples) is J6 gene expressed more: Memory B cells or Plasma cells?
